meta.name: python-project-fingerprint
meta.description: Detect Python project layout and execution conventions by inspecting pyproject.toml, requirements, setup.cfg, test and lint configs. Use before editing unknown Python repositories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析未知 Python 项目的结构与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑前快速了解一个 Python 仓库的布局和约定。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Python project structure and conventions before editing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a Python repo's layout and conventions before editing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动分析 Python 项目的配置文件（如 pyproject.toml、requirements.txt 等），生成一份项目运行指南（RUNBOOK.md）和指纹文件（repo_fingerprint.json），说明如何运行、测试和检查代码。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 编辑一个不熟悉的 Python 仓库时，它会先执行此技能来了解项目结构。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 Python 项目的结构。
say.note: Claude 会扫描配置文件并生成 RUNBOOK.md。

say.text: 这个项目怎么运行测试？
say.note: Claude 会从指纹中提取测试命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically analyzes Python project configuration files (e.g., pyproject.toml, requirements.txt) and produces a RUNBOOK.md and repo_fingerprint.json describing how to run, test, and lint the code.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to edit an unfamiliar Python repository, it will first execute this skill to understand the project layout.

say_en.text: Analyze the structure of this Python project.
say_en.note: Claude scans config files and generates RUNBOOK.md.

say_en.text: How do I run tests in this project?
say_en.note: Claude extracts test commands from the fingerprint.
